integrity: All polynomial coefficients follow from a proved finite-window reduction and two independently coded exhaustive local enumerations; no unverified extrapolation from finite grid sizes. Exact source files and scientific boundaries included.
scientific_limitations: Only two-dimensional Cartesian products of paths with both side lengths at least 2, at distance bounds k=2 or k=3; no stronger priority or independent certification is claimed. The top-degree k=3 cases overlap a pre-existing result, while the complete polynomial size-distribution is the distinct contribution.
title: Complete distance-two and distance-three mutual-visibility polynomials of rectangular grids
